agents_base_url_check.name: agents_base_url_check
agents_base_url_check.value: "agents"."base_url" is null or ("agents"."base_url" like 'https://%' and char_length("agents"."base_url") <= 2048)

rules_model_check.name: rules_model_check
rules_model_check.value: "rules"."model" is null or char_length("rules"."model") between 1 and 200

role_assignments_scope_check.name: role_assignments_scope_check
role_assignments_scope_check.value: ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'org' and "role_assignments"."project_id" is null) or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'project' and "role_assignments"."project_id" is not null)
